key_finding.title: FenceBarRunner + StockBoy supervisor built — automating human-in-the-loop decisions projects +4-5% return on 16-trade sample
key_finding.summary: MFE analysis of 16 fence bar trades revealed 7 losers in 3 predictable patterns (pure losers, reversers, stallers). A human trader would have saved +6.91% by vetoing bad entries, moving stops to breakeven, and taking profit early. We automated these 4 decisions as StockBoy detectors: vol filter override (premarket catalyst check), entry veto (volume/spread/close quality), breakeven stop (MFE stall detection), and early exit (drift detection after peak). The FenceBarRunner is the 4th deterministic runner, registered under StockBoy supervision with paper-only trading. All modules verified — imports clean, 12 existing tests pass, detectors degrade gracefully on data unavailability.
key_finding.verification: 22-month walk-forward (94 windows), 70/30 train/holdout split, slippage sensitivity at 0/2/5/10 bps, MFE/MAE trade-level analysis, StockBoy integration smoke tests, all 12 existing tests pass.
